# Extended regex patterns (case-insensitive) that the commit-hygiene CI
# job rejects in any commit message, one per line. Blank lines and lines
# starting with '#' are ignored. Add a line here to widen the check;
# .github/workflows/ci.yml does not need to change.
#
# Human co-authors stay allowed; only tool attribution is rejected.
co-authored-by:.*(anthropic|claude|openai|chatgpt|copilot|gemini|cursor)
generated (with|by) \[?(claude|chatgpt|copilot|gemini|cursor)
noreply@anthropic\.com
